exposure: practices to deal with obstetric danger signs
outcome: level of awareness of obstetric danger signs
types of traditional practices and home remedies used
preference for healthcare facilities for antenatal care
cohort: The study included 85 married women of reproductive age (mean age 32+-6.80 years) residing in three rural areas around Islamabad, Pakistan.
finding: A majority of women (75%) were unaware of key obstetric danger signs, and deeply-rooted cultural practices, including traditional remedies, were commonly used to manage pregnancy complications before seeking medical care.
